document:
AMINA EL FADILI
Rabat, Morocco
Email: amina.elfadili@example.com
Phone: +212 600 111 222

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Software engineer with six years of experience building backend APIs and retrieval systems for hiring tools. Comfortable with NestJS, Python, and Gemini embeddings. Looking for an internship or first role around generative AI and RAG.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Programming: Python, TypeScript, SQL.
Frameworks: NestJS, FastAPI, Next.js.
AI and data: Gemini embeddings, ChromaDB, LangChain prompt chains, pdf-parse for CV text extraction.
Cloud: Docker Compose, GitHub, Dokploy. No production Vertex AI project yet.
Languages: Arabic (native), French (fluent), English (professional).

EXPERIENCE
AI CV Platform, MindCraft — Backend engineer, 2024 to 2026
Designed a NestJS API that stores candidate CVs in ChromaDB. Each PDF is split into word chunks of about 500 tokens, embedded with gemini-embedding-001, and retrieved with query embeddings. Chat answers are generated with Gemini through LangChain ChatOpenAI on the OpenAI-compatible Gemini endpoint. Built quiz generation that extracts skills then emails a candidate a multiple-choice test.

Acme Health — Backend intern, 2022 to 2024
Worked on appointment APIs in NestJS and wrote integration tests for booking conflicts. Did not work on payroll, billing, or salary systems.

EDUCATION
ENSIAS, Rabat — Engineering degree in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence, expected 2026.
Coursework: information retrieval, neural networks, software architecture.
Capstone: retrieval-augmented chat over internal PDF documents.

CERTIFICATIONS
None listed for Google Cloud or Vertex AI.

ADDITIONAL NOTES
The candidate has not used COBOL, SAP, or Kubernetes in production. Salary, current compensation, and notice period are not stated anywhere in this CV.
